periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, approximately 50 degrees relative to the horizontal axis of the snout.

periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant tapering at the inferior-most point, extending downward towards the mid-cheek region.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, rounded semicircular contouring on both visible pinnae.

other_distinctive_markers: Unusual bipedal (standing) posture exposing the ventral abdominal surface.
